text:
Power Stations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This 
document outlines the equipment 
inspection I1, which must be carried out on yearly 
bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the little block.
The high 
pressure super heater is used for receiving steam from high pressure steam drum 
and making it super heated by exchanging heat with exhaust gases coming from gas 
turbine.
The High Pressure Super Heater technical data:
The first 
draft initiated by eng. Abdallah Saada, revised by eng. Ahmed Elsaaedy, 
accepted by eng. Magdey Hegazy, approved by eng. Khamis Elsherif Maintenance 
General Manager and approved by eng. Abd Elmoaty Elrakayby Head Sector of 
Mahmoudia Power Station.
This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El-Gilil; MEPC Quality Control General Manager 
and MPIS coordinator, and certified by eng. Mohamed Nageeb 
Inspection & Quality Controls Head Sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
The 
 maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID 
 safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes, helmet, breathing mask 
 ... etc
The safety department must check the isolation and surrounding of the zone of 
 work.
The unit is out of service.
Put red tag on the high pressure super heater.
Tools and Equipment
Complete 
 maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.
Argon welding machine.
Grinder & grinding wheel.
Work
to be Carried Out
Fill the high pressure section by filling water from feed 
 water pump after closing drain and opening the vents.
Inspect and adjust the leakage.
Drain the high pressure super 
 heater.
Make hydraulic pressure test for 
 the high pressure section by running the feed water pump to operating press.
Check the distance between pipes 
 is equal.
Check the cleanliness of the 
 surface of pipes.
Check any cracks and use grinding 
 and argon welding according to the manual.
